canonical_data: managed agent sessions, event and item history, sandbox workspaces, and produced artifacts
current_repo_note: This record covers the managed Agents API; Codex and the OpenAI Agents SDK remain distinct operational systems.
strengths: Managed session lifecycle: OpenAI provisions the environment and owns orchestration, context compaction, and recovery while the application supplies tools and chooses hosted or self-hosted execution
Full tool-using loop in the harness: sandboxed code execution, file editing, MCP connections, web search, subagent delegation, and artifact production
Durable sessions with streaming events and webhooks: continue or steer a session across turns and resume where it left off
weaknesses: Beta API surface (agents=v1) offered as-is with no general-availability commitment and excluded from indemnification
Data residency is US-only with no Zero Data Retention eligibility, and session state is retained by the vendor by default
The calling application still owns tool and instruction quality plus the execution environment, and model usage bills separately at API rates
why_it_matters: OpenAI's productization of the Codex harness as a managed runtime API: the durable differentiator is offloading orchestration, compaction, and recovery rather than offering another model endpoint.
